reference.title: 云·率土之滨 官方应用介绍（网易移动游戏）
reference.limitation: This publisher description supplies a 2.25-million-cell baseline, not every season map. Reference axis dimensions have not been verified.

productionGrid.reason: Project-chosen square grid whose 562500 cells equal one quarter of the publisher baseline; 750 is not a claimed measured axis of an official season.

viewport: landscape; viewport aspect does not fix world aspect

chunking.role: data streaming partition; NOT 576 completed art tiles

existingOverview.role: regional scene composition study, not a scale-accurate whole-world map

acceptance: Exactly 750×750 grid addresses, with no gaps or duplicate chunk ownership
World topology, regional boundaries, city and pass placements authored separately from the painted regional plate
All playable starting regions connect to the central contest region through intentional passes
Blocked water and mountains cannot be crossed outside intended crossings
Terrain atlas seam checks and map LOD readability at target device sizes
Actual Unity zoom, streaming, route and occlusion verification
